summary: [¶] The Petitioner, Ayana Renewable Power Private Limited (‘ARPPL’), has filed [para 2] 2. The matter was heard on 6.5.2026 and during the course of the hearing the learned counsel for the Petitioner, ARPPL, submitted that the present Petition has been filed _inter alia_ seeking issuance of directions to CTUIL to extend the date of effectiveness of connectivity of 100 MW Wind Power Plant at Koppal-II PS from 31.12.2025 till 31.12.2027, consequent extension in the date for achieving the financial closure; and not to take any coercive actions against the Petitioner. The learned counsel further submitted that during the pendency of the present Petition, a Letter of [¶] under the Land BG route to the LOA route. Additionally, the Petitioner has also filed Petition No. 109/MP/2026 (Ayana Renewable Power Private Limited (ARPPL) and Another vs CTUIL) before the Commission seeking directions to CTUIL to allow conversion of the Connectivity granted under the Land BG route to the LOA route. [para 3] 3. The learned counsel for the Respondent, CTUIL, confirmed that the Petitioner has applied for conversion of connectivity from the Land-BG route to the LOA route, which is presently pending consideration before CTUIL, and if allowed, the grievance raised in the Petition would not survive. Accordingly, the learned counsel requested that the matter be adjourned for two weeks. [para 4] 4. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, the Petition was admitted, and the parties were directed to complete the pleadings. [para 5] 5. The matter was subsequently heard on 11.6.2026. During the course of the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that during the pendency of the present petition, the Respondent, CTUIL, vide letter dated 22.5.2026, acceded to the request made by the Petitioner and approved the conversion of the existing connectivity to the LOA route for the RTC configuration of 100 MW Wind Power Plant at Koppal-II PS, Karnataka. The learned counsel further submitted that in view of the above, the relief(s) sought in the present Petition have become infructuous, and sought permission to withdraw the present Petition as being rendered infructuous. [para 6] 6. Considering the submissions of the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Petitioner is permitted to withdraw the present Petition. [para 7] 7. Accordingly, Petition No. 154/MP/2026 is disposed of as withdrawn.
title: Petition under Section 79(1)(c), Section 79(1)(f) and Section 79(1)(k) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 65 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023 for seeking extension in the date of effectiveness of 100 MW Connectivity at Koppal-II from 31.12.2025 to 31.12.2026 Ayana Renewable Power Pvt. Ltd.
